dialogues.speaker: Ellin
dialogues.text: It's very scary, but I'm actually not all that worried.

dialogues.speaker: Ellin
dialogues.text: I believe that Master Jean will protect us, and all of Mondstadt!

dialogues.speaker: Ellin
dialogues.text: *sigh* If only I too were a member of the Knights. I do wish that I could fight alongside Master Jean...
